Check yourself. 2. What does the L2-halt scenario test? The answer: Whether your liquidity depends on a single chain.
Check yourself. 3. What's the output of a stress test? The answer: Fixes: smaller caps, bigger buffers, better-placed reserves.

$20k to $14.1k (minus $5.9k) to minus $65.9k (minus 32.9%), Survives, but the payout must fall.

One lending protocol hacked (total loss), minus $25k (minus 12.5%), Survives; cap was 12.5%.
layer two halted 48h, Positions frozen; the reserve on another chain covers needs, Yes, if the reserve isn't on the same layer two.
